lines.text: Early in the morning, the leaders bound Jesus and handed Him over to Herod, who asked if He was King of the Jews.
Pilate had a custom at the feast of releasing a prisoner, and the crowd asked him to keep it.
The chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Barabbas released, and the crowd shouted, "Crucify Him!"
Wishing to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas, had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
The soldiers dressed Jesus in a scarlet robe, set a crown of thorns on His head, and saluted Him.
